f9f591c7139b1a46232d5e944469f2579542d648.summary: Hybrid Analysis sandbox page for an unnamed Windows sample (hash prefix 5d631d774016…) with a score of 100/100 and a malicious rating of 100%. Static analysis and ML by CrowdStrike flagged it with relatively high confidence, and many antivirus engines flagged it. Listed behaviours include a YARA match, unusual PE entropy, registry key monitoring, reads of terminal service keys, process hooking and suspicious API imports. No malware family, actor, CVE, sector or country is named.

f9015ec340e025c16963e9b7cef4cbc3f4101ca7.summary: Group-IB describes JadeProx, a China-nexus operation found through an exposed staging server and active against targets in Vietnam, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Honduras and Venezuela. It centres on the TriBack Loader, which uses DLL sideloading with signed binaries to deliver AdaptixC2 or Beagle. Lures include Claude-themed software, a fake Honduran beverage-company statement and a fake Venezuelan municipal tax portal that collects credentials. Post-exploitation tooling includes iox, suo5, Neo-reGeorg, nuclei and fscan. The report says no single group matches the full picture, so it tracks the…

hedges: However, no single group accounts for the full picture.
In the China-nexus ecosystem, tooling is routinely shared across groups and the presence of the same tools does not mean the same operator.
We track this activity as JadeProx to avoid misattribution and to maintain a clean record of this cluster’s specific artifacts as new activity emerges.
The trident DLL sideloading with signed binaries overlaps with Mustang Panda’s documented PlugX delivery.
Upload regions do not necessarily indicate it as a targeted country.
This was being served to compromised Windows hosts likely delivered via the SOCKS tunnels into internal networks.
Based on the repeated API sequence in all the four variants of TriBack loader, this is likely generated by a custom builder.
The report suggests deliberate selection of the Venezuelan jurisdiction rather than opportunistic deployment.
